results.description:
# Supported Employment Services Award pay rates
Pay rates for [Grade A and B classifications](https://www.fairwork.gov.au/pay-and-wages/minimum-wages/supported-employment-services-award-pay-rates#transitional-pay-rates) under the Supported Employment Services Award increased on 30 June 2026 and again on 1 July 2026.

## Minimum rates for employees with disability
### Grade classifications
#### Grade A
From the first pay period starting on or after 1 July 2026, the minimum pay rate for a full-time or part-time Grade A employee is $8.32 per hour.

#### Grade B
From the first pay period starting on or after 1 July 2026, the minimum pay rate for a full-time or part-time Grade B employee is $16.65 per hour.

## Supported wage assessments
- $3.31 per hour.
